scene.title: Catalyst Lowers Activation Energy
scene.summary: A catalyst provides an alternative pathway that lowers the activation energy of a reaction.

beats.title: No catalyst barrier
beats.narration: The energy profile without a catalyst shows a high peak, the activation energy.

check.question: How does a catalyst affect the activation energy?
check.explain: A catalyst provides a lower‑energy pathway, reducing the activation barrier.

beats.title: Catalyst lowers barrier
beats.narration: Adding a catalyst creates a lower‑energy pathway, reducing the activation energy peak.
